rca_of_issue: Original bug (iter 89): chip onPress unconditionally called save(t.key) for every duty-type chip including Layover, which fired PATCH with layover_city:null and closed the sheet before the user could enter a city. Fix (verified this iteration): the onPress handler now branches — for Layover it only calls setDayType(t.key) so the conditional LAYOVER CITY input + SAVE LAYOVER button render; for the other 7 chips the fast-path save(t.key) is preserved. The explicit SAVE LAYOVER button (testID roster-day-picker-save-layover) calls save() which reads the current city state and posts the PATCH with layover_city set correctly.
